alt: Artist's impressions of the worked examples' known planets, to one scale beside Earth, Neptune and Jupiter, smallest to largest: Earth 1.00 R⊕, Solar System reference; TOI-270 b 1.25 R⊕; HD 15337 b 1.77 R⊕; pi Men c 1.87 R⊕; TOI-270 d 2.13 R⊕; TOI-270 c 2.33 R⊕; HD 15337 c 2.53 R⊕; Neptune 3.88 R⊕, Solar System reference; WASP-126 b 0.96 RJ; Jupiter 1.00 RJ, Solar System reference. Radii: The Extrasolar Planets Encyclopaedia (exoplanet.eu), fetched 2026-10-18 (docs/results/exoplanet_catalogue.json, with the planets named in docs/results/showcase.json, commit 5e92880); 1 RJ = 11.209 R⊕. Each look is chosen from the measured radius and the computed irradiation (setuhq.looks); composition is not measured, and only Earth is drawn with oceans. Drawn by tools/render_stills.mjs --figure lineup on the site renderer's Canvas2D path.
